```{r}
library(fpp2)
library(TTR)
library(forecast)
netflix <- read.csv("NetflixData.csv")
netflix_clean <- na.omit(netflix)
netflix[is.na(netflix)] <- 0
ndiffs(netflix$revenues_USD_thousands)
```

```{r}
fit_arima <- auto.arima(netflix$revenues_USD_thousands, seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE, trace = TRUE)
summary(fit_arima)
attributes(fit_arima)
plot(forecast(fit_arima, h=5))
Acf(fit_arima$residuals)
Box.test(residuals(fit_arima), lag=20, type="Ljung")
checkresiduals(fit_arima)
```
checkresiduals(fit_arima)
